records.source: Need some construction supplies? Or are you looking to re-decorate?
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng mga panustos sa pagtatayo? O gusto mong magpalit ng dekorasyon?

records.source: I have a rotating selection of hand-made furniture.
records.translation: May pabago-bago akong pagpipilian ng gawang-kamay na muwebles.

records.source: I've got some great furniture for sale.
records.translation: May magagandang muwebles akong ipinagbibili.

records.source: Got any spare construction material to sell?
records.translation: May sobra ka bang materyales sa pagtatayo na maipagbibili?

records.source: I've got {2} {0} that would look just {1} in your house.
records.translation: Mayroon akong {2} {0} na magmumukhang {1} sa bahay mo.

records.source: Too lazy to mine your own ore? No problem.
records.translation: Tinatamad kang magmina ng sarili mong mineral? Walang problema.

records.source: I've got lumps of raw metal for sale. Knock yourself out.
records.translation: May mga tipak ako ng hilaw na metal na ipinagbibili. Pumili ka lang.

records.source: Looking to sell any metals or minerals?
records.translation: May metal o mineral ka bang nais ipagbili?

records.source: I can upgrade your tools with more power. You'll have to leave them with me for a few days, though.
records.translation: Mapahuhusay ko ang lakas ng mga kasangkapan mo. Kailangan mo nga lang iwan ang mga iyon sa akin nang ilang araw.

records.source: Need fishing supplies? You've come to the right place.
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng mga panustos sa pangingisda? Nasa tamang lugar ka.

records.source: Sorry about the smell.
records.translation: Paumanhin sa amoy.

records.source: Need some supplies?
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng mga panustos?

records.source: Don't forget to check out my daily wallpaper and flooring selection!
records.translation: Huwag kalimutang tingnan ang araw-araw kong pagpipilian ng disenyo para sa dingding at sahig!

records.source: What can I get for you?
records.translation: Ano ang maihahanda ko para sa iyo?

records.source: I carry only the finest goods.
records.translation: Tanging pinakamagagandang paninda ang tinitinda ko.

records.source: I've got quality goods for sale.
records.translation: May de-kalidad akong panindang ipinagbibili.

records.source: Looking to buy something?
records.translation: May gusto ka bang bilhin?

records.source: Got anything you want to sell?
records.translation: May gusto ka bang ipagbili?

records.source: Welcome to Pierre's!
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa tindahan ni Pierre!

records.source: The season's almost over. I'll be changing stock tomorrow.
records.translation: Malapit nang matapos ang panahon. Papalitan ko ang mga paninda bukas.

records.source: Buy something?
records.translation: May bibilhin ka ba?

records.source: Hiyo, poke. Did you bring coins? Gud. Me sell hats.
records.translation: Hiyo, poke. May dala barya? Gud. Ako benta sombrero.
records.englishResidueReason: Hiyo, poke, and Gud are invented phonetic fragments in the Hat Mouse's deliberately broken character voice, preserved while translating its meaning directly.

records.source: Rare Goods
records.translation: Pambihirang Paninda

records.source: I've got a little bit of everything. Take a look!
records.translation: May sari-sari akong paninda. Tingnan mo!

records.source: I smuggled these goods out of the Gotoro Empire. Why do you think they're so expensive?
records.translation: Ipinalusot ko ang mga panindang ito mula sa Imperyo ng Gotoro. Bakit mo akalaing napakamahal ng mga ito?

records.source: I'll have new items every week, so make sure to come back!
records.translation: Magkakaroon ako ng mga bagong paninda bawat linggo, kaya tiyaking bumalik ka!

records.source: Let me see... Oh! I've got just what you need: {0}!
records.translation: Tingnan natin... Ah! Mayroon ako ng mismong kailangan mo: {0}!

records.source: Beautiful country you have here. One of my favorite stops. The pig likes it, too.
records.translation: Maganda ang lupain ninyo rito. Isa ito sa mga paborito kong hintuan. Nagugustuhan din ito ng baboy.

records.source: Animal supplies for sale!
records.translation: Mga panustos sa hayop, ipinagbibili!

records.source: *sigh*... When the door opened I thought it might be Lewis.
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Nang bumukas ang pinto, akala ko baka si Lewis iyon.

records.source: What'll you have?
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo?

records.source: Can you smell that? It's the {0}
records.translation: Naaamoy mo ba iyon? Iyon ang {0}

records.source: Hungry? Thirsty? I've got just the thing.
records.translation: Gutom? Uhaw? Mayroon ako ng mismong kailangan mo.

records.source: Welcome to the Stardrop Saloon! What can I get ya?
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Saloon ng Patak-Bituin! Ano'ng maibibigay ko sa iyo?
records.englishResidueReason: Saloon is retained in the canonical Filipino glossary's established venue name.

records.source: The caves can be dangerous. Make sure you're prepared.
records.translation: Maaaring mapanganib ang mga yungib. Tiyaking handa ka.

records.source: In the market for a new sword?
records.translation: Naghahanap ka ba ng bagong espada?

records.source: Welcome to the adventurer's guild.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Samahan ng mga Adventurer.
records.englishResidueReason: Adventurer is retained by the canonical Filipino glossary as the organization's established in-world title.

records.source: Slay any monsters? I'll buy the loot.
records.translation: Nakapatay ka ba ng mga halimaw? Bibilhin ko ang nasamsam mo.

records.source: The caves can be dangerous. How do you think I lost this eye?
records.translation: Maaaring mapanganib ang mga yungib. Paano sa palagay mo nawala ang mata kong ito?

records.source: You won't find these goods anywhere else!
records.translation: Hindi mo makikita ang mga panindang ito saanman!
